description: Given a domain, read whatever it publishes at the standard machine-discovery locations (llms.txt, /.well-known/ard.json, /.well-known/agent-card.json, /.well-known/api-catalog, ai-info.json, openapi.json, and more) and return one normalized answer. Each resource keeps a sourceUrl pointing back to the domain so the caller can verify. NessGate reads the domain live and stores nothing; it makes no ownership or safety claim.
name: discover_domain
title: Resolve a domain's machine-readable resources
